home.title: Book your course
home.subtitle: Choose a package, select the days and times you prefer and send your request. You will be contacted for confirmation.

home.ratesSubtitle: Price per single lesson, by length.

booking.pickDay: Pick a highlighted day to see the free times.
booking.noSlots: No free times on this day.
booking.blockHint: Click the start time: a {minutes}-minute block will be selected. Click a selected time to remove it. Greyed-out times leave no room for a full block before availability ends.
booking.full: You have chosen all the lessons included in the package.
booking.disclaimer: This is a request: dates are not confirmed until you are contacted.

booking.groupSeats: {n, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}

errors.COUNT_MISMATCH: You must book {required} minutes of lessons in total (now {selected}).
errors.LESSON_TOO_SHORT: The lesson on {day} at {time} is too short: at least {min} minutes.
errors.LESSON_TOO_LONG: The lesson on {day} at {time} is too long: maximum {max} minutes.
errors.LESSON_STEP: The lesson on {day} at {time} must last a multiple of {step} minutes.

errors.SLOT_TAKEN: One of the times was just booked by someone else. Please update your selection.
errors.OUTSIDE_WINDOW: The lesson on {day} at {time} is outside the course time slots.
errors.LESSON_FULL: One of the group lessons has just filled up. Please update your selection.
errors.PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Please complete your profile to continue.
errors.VALIDATION: The selection does not match the package rules.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too many code requests. Please try again in a few minutes.

login.title: Sign in with your email
login.intro: We will send you a 6-digit verification code. No password needed.
login.sent: We sent a code to {email}. Check your spam folder too.

profile.title: Your details
profile.intro: We need them to contact you and organise the lessons.
profile.fromBooking: Last step: enter your details to send the request. We keep them, so they will be ready for your next bookings.
profile.guardianConsent: I am the parent/guardian and I consent to the processing of the minor's data.
profile.privacy: I have read the <link>privacy notice</link> and I consent to the processing of my data to manage the booking.
profile.savedBody: They will be ready for your next requests.
profile.savedBodyNext: Now we will send your booking request.
profile.invalidBilling: Please check the invoicing details: some fields are not valid.

billing.title: Invoicing details
billing.intro: Needed to issue the invoice after payment. Enter them once: they apply to all your requests.
billing.holderHint: Invoice holder: it can be someone else, for example a parent.
billing.sdiHint: If you give neither an SDI code nor a PEC address, the e-invoice will still be available in your tax drawer (cassetto fiscale).

errors.taxCode: Invalid tax code: please check letters and digits.
errors.vatNumber: Invalid VAT number: 11 correct digits are required.

done.title: Request sent!
done.text: Thank you! We received your request and sent you a summary email. You will be contacted shortly to confirm the dates and complete your order.

myRequests.title: My requests
myRequests.empty: You have not sent any request yet.

requests.title: Booking requests
requests.noSdi: No SDI code or PEC: use recipient code 0000000.
requests.noBilling: The client has not entered invoicing details.

availability.title: Availability
availability.help: Open a day and click the times to make them available: each box is a quarter of an hour, each row an hour. Booked times cannot be removed.
availability.apply3: Apply to every {weekday} for the next 3 months

packages.title: Packages
packages.descriptionIt: Summary (Italian) · on the home page card
packages.descriptionEn: Summary (English) · on the home page card
packages.detailsIt: Full description (Italian) · on the course page
packages.detailsEn: Full description (English) · on the course page

editor.altPrompt: Short description of the image (for people who can’t see it)
editor.hint: Left/right images sit beside the text; on phones they go full width, and the two columns stack.

packages.validityDays: Validity (days between first and last lesson)
packages.maxLessonsPerWeek: Max lessons per week (empty = no limit)
packages.maxParticipantsHint: 1 = one-to-one lessons. With more seats, the first client sets the lesson and others can join while seats are left.
packages.groupKeyHint: Packages with the same group and lesson length share group lessons (e.g. “4 hours” and “8 hours” of the same course). Best give them all the same number of seats.

windows.title: Course time slots
windows.none: No time slots: the course can be booked whenever you are available.
windows.hint: Lessons must fit entirely within one time slot and within the availability set in the calendar.

packages.deactivated: The package has requests: it was deactivated instead of deleted.
packages.lessonMinutes: Length of each lesson (from the price list)
packages.summary: {n, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} of {duration} = {hours, number} hours.
packages.priceHint: Optional. If lower than the full price, clients see the full price struck through and the discount percentage. Empty = full price.
packages.noRate: This length has no price in the price list yet.
packages.variableLegacy: This package had a variable lesson length: saving it makes the length fixed.

clients.title: Clients
clients.name: Name
clients.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete the client and all their requests?

settings.title: Settings
settings.adminNotifyEmail: Additional notification email (administrators already receive them)

admins.title: Administrators
admins.added: Administrator added. They can sign in with their email and the verification code.
admins.hint: If the email belongs to a registered client, they become an administrator; otherwise the account is created and becomes active on first sign-in.
admins.removeConfirm: Remove administrator rights from {email}? They will remain a client.

rates.title: Price list
rates.hint: Price of one lesson of each length, shown in the Prices section of the home page. For each package, lessons × rate is the full price: if you give the package a lower price, clients see the discount. Leave the price empty if not decided yet.

errors.INVALID: Check the values: lengths in multiples of 15 minutes, prices in euro.
errors.DUPLICATE: Each length can appear only once.
errors.IN_USE: A length you want to remove is used by a package: change the package first.

ratesPage.title: Prices section on the home page
ratesPage.hint: Title, subtitle and description shown above the price cards at the bottom of the home page. Leave empty to use the default texts.
ratesPage.defaultSubtitleIt: Prezzo per singola lezione, in base alla durata.
ratesPage.defaultSubtitleEn: Price per single lesson, by length.
ratesPage.invalid: Check the fields: some texts are too long.

media.hintBanner: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB. Ideally at least 1600×600 px.
media.hintLogo: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB. Ideally square, at least 256×256 px.
media.hintContent: JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF up to 5 MB. Ideally at least 1200 px wide.

errors.BAD_TYPE: Unsupported format: use JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
errors.IN_USE: The image is in use (theme, package or package description): replace it before deleting it.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

theme.title: Site appearance
theme.intro: Colours, fonts, shapes, banner and images. Changes show in the preview right away and go live only when you save.
theme.presetsHint: Applies the colours, fonts, shapes and banner of a style: your texts and logo stay. You can fine-tune everything after.

fields.showName: Show the name next to the logo
fields.heading: Heading colour
fields.cardAccentBar: Coloured bar on top of cards
fields.headerSticky: Keep the header visible while scrolling
fields.heroEnabled: Show the banner on the home page
fields.showRates: Show the price list on the home page

help.primary: Becomes the button shade: lighter and darker tints are derived from it.
help.neutral: A warm grey (a touch of red or yellow) makes the whole site feel more welcoming.
help.baseSize: Scales all text on the site. The preview shows it after saving.
help.heroOverlayOpacity: Darkens the image so the text stays readable.
help.logoUrl: A PNG with a transparent background works best.
help.showRates: Only durations with a price appear (Admin → Packages).
